title: Outerwear-minded client awaiting a post-fitting call and birthday gesture
brief: Mme Dupont has been with the Maison since mid-2024, with two purchases made within about seven weeks and none since. She is now with a new associate at Emeria Lisbon, and several follow-up tasks are open around an autumn fitting.
prose: Her two baskets, in May and July 2024, centred on jackets and tops: an Amigo jacket (two units), an Atami down jacket, an Acacia jacket, a Cliff polo and a Cesar tee. She also bought two units of ski wax, which hints at a mountain or ski-leaning wardrobe, though the dossier does not confirm it. Her last purchase dates back to July 2024, so she has been quiet for a long time. Her assignment to the Lisbon boutique and her current associate was recorded in July 2026. The history shows a series of planned autumn-collection fittings, several tagged back-in-stock, and repeated to-do tasks to call her back after the fitting. Some of these tasks carry a birthday tag, and a task to buy a birthday gift is due on 20 September 2026. No messages, notes, stated preferences or open promises are recorded, so her tastes and preferred channel remain unknown.
nextStep: Call Mme Dupont for the post-fitting follow-up, as the open tasks indicate, and ask how she found the pièces she tried. Weave in a discreet birthday attention, and have the gift ready by 20 September. Keep the tone warm and unhurried, with no pressure to buy and no mention of price.
